;Arts and culture
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on television]], [[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on cinema]]
***Actors [[Idris Elba]] and [[Kristofer Hivju]] reveal they have both tested positive for COVID-19. [https://www.foxnews.com/entertainment/idris-elba-tests-positive-coronavirus (Fox News)] [https://variety.com/2020/tv/news/game-of-thrones-star-kristofer-hivju-coronavirus-1203536037/ (''Variety'')]
*[[Rock art in Iran]]
**An ancient [[petroglyph]] has been discovered in [[Central Iran]]. [https://www.newsweek.com/ancient-petroglyph-creature-that-half-man-half-mantis-discovered-iran-1492573 (''Newsweek'')]

;Business and economy
*[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]], [[2020 stock market crash]]
***Asian markets fall substantially and European markets open with huge losses. [[S&P futures]] fall 5%, triggering a [[trading halt]] in response to the [[Federal Reserve]]'s emergency measures. [https://abcnews.go.com/Business/wireStory/stock-futures-sink-rate-cut-virus-restrictions-69611389 (ABC News)]
***The [[Dow Jones Industrial Average|Dow]] closes 2,997 points or 12.9% lower - its [[list of largest daily changes in the Dow Jones Industrial Average|largest daily points movement]]. [https://www.mercurynews.com/2020/03/16/dow-drops-more-than-2999-points-on-recession-fears/ (AP via ''Mercury News'')]
**[[Renault]] announces that it is halting all production at its industrial sites in [[France]] until further notice because of the coronavirus pandemic. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-france-renault/french-carmaker-renault-to-halt-production-in-france-idUKKBN2132RH (Reuters)]
**The 2020 [[Dayton Hamvention]], the world's largest [[amateur radio]] convention, is cancelled due to the coronavirus pandemic. [https://swling.com/blog/2020/03/hamvention-2020-has-been-cancelled/ (The Shortwave Listening Post)]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 vaccine]]
***[[Kaiser Permanente|Kaiser Permanente Washington Health Research Institute]] in [[Seattle]] begins testing a possible COVID-19 vaccine on 45 people. [https://komonews.com/news/coronavirus/government-official-coronavirus-vaccine-trial-starts-monday-in-seattle (KOMO-TV)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]], [[2020 Spain coronavirus lockdown]]
****Regional presidents of the [[Community of Madrid]], [[Isabel Díaz Ayuso]], and [[Catalonia]], [[Quim Torra]], test positive for [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]], as both regions are the most affected by the pandemic in the country. [https://www.rtve.es/noticias/20200316/quim-torra-isabel-diaz-ayuso-dan-positivo-coronavirus/2010137.shtml (RTVE)]
****The [[Government of Spain|Spanish government]] takes control of all [[private hospital]]s to help the country's healthcare system cope with the virus pandemic. [https://www.businessinsider.com/coronavirus-spain-nationalises-private-hospitals-emergency-covid-19-lockdown-2020-3?r=US&IR=T (''Business Insider'')]
****[[2020 Basque regional election|Basque]] and [[2020 Galician regional election|Galician elections]], both scheduled for 5 April are postponed until the crisis is overcome. [https://elpais.com/espana/2020-03-16/urkullu-aplaza-las-elecciones-vascas-hasta-superar-la-crisis-del-coronavirus.html (''El País'')]
****The [[Ministry of the Interior (Spain)|Ministry of the Interior]] closes all borders. [https://english.elpais.com/society/2020-03-16/spain-closes-its-borders-to-contain-coronavirus.html (''El País'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Poland]]
****Poland's Environment Minister {{ill|Michał Woś|pl}} tests positive for COVID-19. Other Cabinet ministers' workers self-isolate but later test negative. [https://polskieradio24.pl/395/7784/Artykul/2477511,Polish-agriculture-minister-quarantined-after-deputy-tests-positive-for-Covid19 (Radio Poland)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Greenland]]
****[[Greenland]] reports its first confirmed case of COVID-19, in [[Nuuk]]. [https://ekstrabladet.dk/nyheder/samfund/groenland-har-konstateret-sit-foerste-tilfaelde-af-coronavirus/8050456?fbclid=IwAR0T0_j_N8bByqUlix7BUcbesaEVwgl2he2ryX1VOum96we6IkXrXvE0pOA (''Ekstra Bladet'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Finland]]
****[[Finland]]'s [[Prime Minister of Finland|Prime Minister]] [[Sanna Marin]] declares a [[state of emergency]] and closes all schools until April 13 in response to the coronavirus. [https://yle.fi/uutiset/osasto/news/finland_closes_schools_declares_state_of_emergency_over_coronavirus/11260062 (YLE)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****The first death from COVID-19 is confirmed in [[Wales]]. The 68-year-old patient was being treated at [[Wrexham Maelor Hospital]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-wales-51909109 (BBC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Armenia]]
****[[Armenia]] declares a state of emergency lasting until April 14 to prevent the spread of the coronavirus. The emergency measures include the closure of all educational institutions, closing the borders with [[Georgia (country)|Georgia]] and Iran, banning gatherings with over 20 people, and postponing the [[2020 Armenian constitutional referendum]]. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-health-coronavirus-armenia-emergency/armenia-declares-one-month-state-of-emergency-for-coronavirus-idUKKBN2132TQ?il=0 (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malta]]
****[[Prime Minister of Malta|Prime Minister]] [[Robert Abela]] announces the closing of all public locals but refuses to order a lockdown. [https://timesofmalta.com/articles/view/all-public-places-bars-restaurants-to-be-shut-amid-coronavirus-spread.778604 (''Times of Malta'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Andorra]]
****The COVID-19 cases in Andorra amount to 14 after a rise of 9 on the day with the highest cases registered. [[Prime Minister of Andorra|Prime Minister]] also announces the stoppage of construction and industry for 8 days. [https://www.diariandorra.ad/noticies/nacional/2020/03/16/catorze_positius_per_coronavirus_158662_1125.html (''Diari d'Andorra'')] [https://www.diariandorra.ad/noticies/nacional/2020/03/16/govern_atura_construccio_les_activitats_industrials_vuit_dies_158672_1125.html (''Diari d'Andorra'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Monaco]]
****[[Minister of State (Monaco)|Head of the Monegasque government]] [[Serge Telle]] tests positive for COVID-19. [https://edition.cnn.com/world/live-news/coronavirus-outbreak-03-17-20-intl-hnk/h_76ed1567e8b30480788c9e42f5589ce4 (CNN)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iceland]]
****All schools including primary and preschool in the [[Reykjavík]] area closes. [https://www.ruv.is/frett/hvorki-grunnskoli-ne-leikskoli-a-manudaginn (RUV)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Bahrain]]
***[[Bahrain]] reports the country's first death from COVID-19, a 65-year-old woman who returned from [[Iran]] last month. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/asia-pacific/bahrain-reports-first-coronavirus-death/1767582 (Anadolu Agency)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Israel]]
***[[Ministry of Health (Israel)|Israel’s Health Ministry]] approves experimental treatment for COVID-19. [https://www.jpost.com/Israel-News/Health-Ministry-approves-experimental-treatments-for-coronavirus-621209 (''Jerusalem Post'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Africa]]
***[[Benin]], [[Liberia]], [[Somalia]] and [[Tanzania]] report their first confirmed cases of COVID-19. [https://nationalpost.com/pmn/health-pmn/somalia-liberia-benin-and-tanzania-confirm-first-coronavirus-cases (''National Post'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Sudan]]
****[[Sudan]] declares the emergency status. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/africa/sudan-declares-health-emergency-over-coronavirus/1768166 (Anadolu Agency)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]]
***[[Ayatollah|Grand Ayatollah]] [[Hashem Bathaie Golpayenagi]] dies two days after testing positive for COVID-19, as Iran's [[Ministry of Health and Medical Education]] reports 129 more deaths from the virus. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/03/iran-reports-113-virus-deaths-containment-concerns-mount-200315180552632.html (Al Jazeera)]
***Economist and social activist [[Fariborz Raisdana]] also dies from coronavirus. [https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/446203/Ayatollah-Bathaei-Golpayegani-dies-of-coronavirus (''Tehran Times'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Turkey]]
***Turkey's [[Directorate of Religious Affairs]] imposes a nationwide ban on all prayer gatherings in [[mosque]]s. [https://www.dailysabah.com/turkey/turkish-diyanet-bans-prayers-in-mosques-due-to-coronavirus/news (''Daily Sabah'')]
***Turkey's [[Ministry of Health (Turkey)|Ministry of Health]] confirms 29 new cases, totalling to 47. [https://www.dailysabah.com/turkey/number-of-coronavirus-cases-in-turkey-rises-to-47/news (''Daily Sabah'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
***[[Russian government]] has decided to provisionally limit the entry of foreigners into Russia to prevent the spread of COVID-19. The rules will come to force on Wednesday and will last until May 1. Diplomats, those "residing permanently in Russia", along with some other categories e.g. crews of aircraft, international truck drivers and people who attend funerals are exempted. [https://rt.com/russia/483270-russia-entry-foreign-nationals/ (RT)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***The U.S. has 4,459 confirmed cases of COVID-19 as of today, resulting in 86 deaths. [[West Virginia]] remains the only state with no confirmed cases. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/03/03/health/us-coronavirus-cases-state-by-state/index.html (CNN)]
***All [[K–12]] schools are closed in 37 U.S. states as of today, affecting a total of 37.4 million students in 72,000 schools. [https://www.edweek.org/ew/section/multimedia/map-coronavirus-and-school-closures.html (''Education Week'')]
***The [[San Francisco Bay Area]] orders a [[shelter in place]] for six counties. [https://www.sfchronicle.com/local-politics/article/Bay-Area-must-shelter-in-place-Only-15135014.php (''San Francisco Chronicle'')]
***The governors of [[New York (state)|New York]], [[New Jersey]], [[Connecticut]], [[Michigan]], [[Louisiana]], [[Ohio]], [[Illinois]], [[Massachusetts]], and [[Washington (state)|Washington]], and mayors of cities in other states, order the closure of all bars and restaurants and ban gatherings of 50 or more people in their states or cities in response to the pandemic. [https://www.cnbc.com/2020/03/16/new-york-new-jersey-and-connecticut-agree-to-close-restaurants-limit-events-to-less-than-50-people.html (CNBC)] [https://www.fox2detroit.com/news/gov-whitmer-to-temporarily-shut-down-all-bars-restaurants-to-eat-in-service (WJBK)] [https://www.businessinsider.com/states-cities-shutting-down-bars-restaurants-concerts-curfew-2020-3 (''Business Insider'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Netherlands]]
***[[Prime Minister of the Netherlands|Prime Minister]] [[Mark Rutte]] becomes the first Prime Minister since 1973 to hold a rare televised address to the nation concerning the coronavirus pandemic. [https://www.politico.eu/article/dutch-pm-mark-rutte-we-wont-impose-national-lockdown-coronavirus-covid19/ (''Politico'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
***Prime Minister [[Justin Trudeau]] announces that Canada will close its borders to all foreign travelers due to the pandemic, effective on Wednesday. Exceptions will be made for air crews, diplomats, immediate family members and U.S. citizens. Only four airports will continue to receive international flights: [[Toronto Pearson International Airport|Toronto Pearson]], [[Vancouver International Airport|Vancouver]], [[Montréal–Trudeau International Airport|Montréal–Trudeau]], and [[Calgary International Airport|Calgary]]. Domestic flights and flights from the United States, Mexico, and the Caribbean, as well as foreign commerce and trade, will not be affected. [https://globalnews.ca/news/6682040/coronavirus-trudeau-address-nation/ (Global News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]]
***[[President of the Philippines|Philippine President]] [[Rodrigo Duterte]] declares a [[Luzon]]-wide "enhanced community quarantine" during the second day of the already community quarantined [[Metro Manila]]. [https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/news/nation/729875/duterte-orders-lockdown-of-entire-luzon-due-to-covid-19-threat/story/ (GMA News)]
***[[Senate of the Philippines|Philippine Senator]] [[Migz Zubiri]] becomes one of the 142 cases of COVID-19 in the Philippines after his test results return positive. [https://www.cnnphilippines.com/news/2020/3/16/Migz-Zubiri-COVID-19-positive.html (CNN Philippines)]

;Law and crime
*Aftermath of the [[Sagamihara stabbings]]
**A court in Japan sentences Satoshi Uematsu [[capital punishment in Japan|to death]] for one of the country's worst [[mass murder]]s, in which he killed 19 [[disability in Japan|disabled]] people. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-51903289 (BBC News)]
*The [[Constitutional Court of Russia]] approves [[2020 amendments to the Constitution of Russia|amendments]] to the [[Constitution of Russia|Constitution]] proposed by [[President of Russia|President]] [[Vladimir Putin]]. [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2020/03/16/russias-top-court-approves-putin-reform-plan-to-stay-president-until-2036-a69643 (''The Moscow Times'')]
*[[Mass shootings in the United States]]
**A man shoots six people, killing four and himself, at a gas station in [[Springfield, Missouri]]. [https://thehill.com/homenews/state-watch/487793-police-officer-gunman-among-5-dead-in-missouri-shooting (''The Hill'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries]]
**[[Joe Biden]] is declared winner of the [[2020 Washington Democratic primary|Washington Democratic primary]]. [https://www.politico.com/news/2020/03/16/biden-washington-primary-133106 (''Politico'')]

;Sports
*[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports]]
**[[2020 Major League Baseball season]]
***[[Major League Baseball]] announces that the season will be postponed indefinitely, after the recommendations from the [[Centers for Disease Control and Prevention|CDC]] to restrict events of more than 50 people for the next eight weeks. [https://www.mlb.com/news/opening-of-regular-season-to-be-pushed-back (Major League Baseball)]
**The [[National Junior College Athletic Association]] cancels the remainder of all winter seasons, plus the spring seasons, for all sports. [https://www.mlive.com/sports/2020/03/njcaa-cancels-spring-sports-basketball-nationals-amid-coronavirus-outbreak.html (MLive.com)]
**[[WrestleMania 36]]
***[[WWE]] announces that this year's edition of its flagship event, [[WrestleMania]], will be moved from [[Raymond James Stadium]] in [[Tampa, Florida]], to the [[WWE Performance Center]] in [[Orlando, Florida|Orlando]], Florida, [[Behind closed doors (sport)|without a live crowd]]. [https://www.f4wonline.com/wwe-news/wrestlemania-36-air-live-wwe-performance-center-306716 (''Wrestling Observer'')]
**[[2020 NFL Draft]]
***The 2020 [[National Football League Draft|NFL draft]] will go ahead in April despite the coronavirus, but with new changes. [https://www.bostonherald.com/2020/03/16/nfl-draft-will-proceed-in-late-april-with-changes-league-announces/ (''Boston Herald'')] [https://www.nbcsports.com/philadelphia/eagles/nfl-draft-2020-coronavirus-no-fans (NBC Sports)]
